summary_en: Yurtec will acquire up to 800,000 shares (approximately 1.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for up to 2.04 billion yen via ToSTNeT-3 at a fixed price of 2,550 yen per share on October 29, 2026. This is the first tranche execution under the 1.7 million-share, 5.5 billion yen buyback program authorized by the board on the same date, with remaining capacity to be deployed through open market purchases.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
On October 28, 2026, Yurtec Corporation's board of directors authorized a share repurchase program and immediately executed the first tranche through a scheduled block acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours trading). The company will acquire up to 800,000 shares at a fixed price of 2,550 yen per share on October 29, 2026, with a maximum outlay of 2.04 billion yen. This represents approximately 1.2% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock.

This execution follows the board's authorization of a broader 1.7 million-share program (2.47% of outstanding shares) with a 5.5 billion yen budget and a acquisition period extending through March 12, 2027. The ToSTNeT-3 purchase on October 29 serves as the first tranche under this program. Any unsold portion may still be acquired, though market conditions could affect execution.

Following completion of the ToSTNeT-3 block purchase, the company intends to deploy the remaining authorized shares through open market purchases under a discretionary trading agreement. The fixed-price block acquisition method provides certainty on execution price and volume within the specified limits, with results to be announced after the trading session concludes on October 29.
